statements.impact_statement: urllib3 2.7.0 exists only as pip's vendored copy (pip/_vendor and the ensurepip bundled wheel in the upstream python base image). It is exercised solely by pip's own operations, which never run in the deployed container. No pip release vendoring the fixed 2.8.0 exists (vendor.txt checked through pip 26.2.0); remove this statement once one ships.
